2609.18317.title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering
2609.18317.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability. We benchmark Graph-RAG against standard RAG on LatamQA, a culturally grounded multiple-choice dataset spanning eight thematic categories. The graphs are built end-to-end from Wikipedia articles with KGGen, a recent open-domain extractor, without manual curation in our main setting. G-Retriever is competitive with RAG and reduces the error of the base LLM by 72\% with a standard KG and 78\% with a benchmark-aware variant, the gap to RAG narrowing further as the graph is oriented toward task-relevant content. The trained projection transfers zero-shot to Portuguese without target-language fine-tuning, indicating multilingual reach.
2609.18317.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型 (LLMs) 面臨長尾不足的問題：文化特定的事實，尤其是那些與拉丁美洲等代表性不足的地區有關的事實，在預訓練語料中出現得太少，無法被可靠地記住。檢索增強生成 (RAG) 通過將生成基於外部文本來解決這一問題，但結構化的替代方案，如知識圖譜 (KGs)，則提供了對進入上下文的內容更緊密的控制，以及在可解釋性和可更新性方面的潛在收益。我們在 LatamQA 上對 Graph-RAG 與標準 RAG 進行基準測試，這是一個涵蓋八個主題類別的文化基礎多選數據集。這些圖是從維基百科文章中端到端構建的，使用 KGGen，一個最近的開放領域提取器，在我們的主要設置中沒有手動策劃。G-Retriever 與 RAG 競爭，並且在標準 KG 下將基礎 LLM 的錯誤率降低了 72\%，在基準感知變體下降低了 78\%，隨著圖的方向朝向任務相關內容，與 RAG 的差距進一步縮小。訓練後的投影在不進行目標語言微調的情況下實現了零樣本轉移到葡萄牙語，顯示出多語言的覆蓋範圍。
